about: The Marygold Companies, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides fund management services to exchange traded fund and exchange traded products in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. It operates through Fund Management, Security Systems, Beauty Products, and Financial Services segments. The company engages in management, operation, and investment advisement to exchange traded funds organized as limited partnerships or investment trusts that issue shares which trade on the NYSE Arca stock exchange. It is also involved in sale and installation of commercial and residential alarm monitoring systems; wholesale distribution of hair and skin care products; development of a Fintech app; and asset management. The company was formerly known as Concierge Technologies, Inc. and changed its name to The Marygold Companies Inc. in March 2022. The Marygold Companies Inc. was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in San Clemente, California.
